findings.title: paginate() offset skips the first page
findings.description: Pages are 1-based (page defaults to 1 and is clamped to >= 1), but the extracted paginate computes start = page * pageSize instead of the original (page - 1) * pageSize; page 1 now returns results 20-39 and the first page is unreachable. Restore (page - 1) * pageSize.
